The '''Kintarr system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Kintarrian Death Drum]]s|system=Kintarr [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the musical instrument known as [[Kintarrian Death Drum]]s.<ref name="MiniaturesBattlesCompanion">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kintarr [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
